new_rules.R10_joint_age: coarsened source gap blocks; minimum-change within original synthetic bins; operator/berth conditions retained; parentage subtype unknown; one unmatched graft member has no source gap claim
new_rules.R11_service_purpose: laundry clean-batch handover and two-set crockery next dinner are explicit task contracts before A, independent of operator windows
new_rules.R12_partition_continuity: daily morning carry-clearance reservation per installed batch appliance; explicit predecessor; fixed date-local A independent of prior length
new_rules.R13_execution: separate requested load/program/unload and delivered batch; interlock and cancellation are given reference policies; no retry or rejection labels
new_rules.R14_vehicle: connection and actual presence gate charge; departure blocked by connection/energy deficit; alternate travel unmodelled
new_rules.R15_care: book baseline departure cover before B; unchanged booking shared; B extra help not presumed
new_rules.R16_input: static question prompts exclude score state; visible context observations recorded as history; IDs and dated follow-up requirements shown
new_rules.R17_energy: finite-window electricity and terminal storage reported; no forced recovery or equal-service net saving claim
new_rules.R18_bath: bath resource and currently free resident helper chosen jointly; no invented work break; exact external appointment only when no resident option; all common to A/B
new_rules.R19_reference_physics: bounded original EB temperature modifiers with visible domain limits and actual raw-input records; no limit widening or real OEM claim; model-form sensitivity is not empirical validation
new_rules.R20_EP_gate: content-bound automatic scientific and purpose review before engine calls; original50 only, no full1000 default
